claim: Patchline ships a single command that reproduces the entire paper, all studies, and all figures in a clean container. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the clean container claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make one-command-paper-repro-gate`.
